editorial.blurb: A humble, authentic vermicelli spot where friendly staff guide you through a delicious menu of hand-pulled noodles and house-made toppings.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive with cash and explore the side counter of toppings and add-ins to customize your bowl—the staff will help you navigate even if English isn't their strong suit.

topDishes.note: Affordable at $15, reviewers call it incredible
Hearty and delicious, perfect for cold afternoons
Authentic taste that hits just right
